title: Rating Rule Card — Collision Reports of a Resident Listed Again on the Owner Auto Policy
content:
**Accident relativity on re-listing.** Under the company's filed driver rating, an accident relativity multiplies the share of a household resident listed again on the Owner Auto Policy. The share is multiplied before it is rounded to the cent.

The relativity counts claim reports of the term on the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision) claim file. A report counts when it names the resident as operator while the resident was an unlisted household resident, with a collision cause (a collision with another vehicle, or a single-vehicle collision). The recorded share, rated while the resident was listed, does not carry these reports.

| Such claim reports | Relativity |
|---|---|
| two or more | 1.45 |
| one | 1.25 |
| none | 1 |

**Points of judgement (hypothetical).**
- A collision report naming the resident at a time when the resident was recorded as a rated driver does not count. Only reports recording the resident as an unlisted household resident count.
- One single-vehicle collision report recording the resident as unlisted gives 1.25.
